lanes.summary: The diff correctly implements all requirements of PMAT-3556. The Python decider implements the five refusals, mapping them to UNMEASURABLE (exit 2) and reporting per-mode fits for the bimodal case as required. The driver measures TTFT off the SSE stream, issues a unique nonce per sample, discards warm-up requests, and establishes OUT/MARKER with a python-free bail_marker before any step that can fail early. The marker vocabulary consistently uses UNMEASURABLE. No forbidden files were modified. The dissenting claims from Lane 2 are contradicted by the actual diff, which explicitly handles the defects observed in the previous draft.

findings.claim: The probe writes a marker on every exit path via `bail_marker` and `write_marker`, properly covering early failures of `cd` and `apr_bin.sh` before they can occur without a marker.
The string passed to write_marker for exit 2 is UNMEASURABLE, which matches the documented exit codes.

findings.claim: The diff commits a temporary process ID file (lanes.pids), which the ticket does not ask for and which should not be tracked in version control.

lanes.summary: Review of PMAT-3556 (Lane 3 of 3): Verified complete compliance with PMAT-3556 ticket requirements and receipt details. Added scripts/perf002_prefill_path_probe.sh, scripts/perf002_prefill_path_probe.py, roadmap entry PMAT-3556, updated PP-LLAMA-001-MASTER.md, and audit receipt docs/audits/impl-PMAT-3556-receipt.md. Python selftest passed cleanly with 8/8 cases verified. Early failure paths in the bash driver write markers properly prior to sourcing or changing directories, using UNMEASURABLE for exit 2. No forbidden files under crates/aprender-serve/** or .github/workflows/cuda-nightly.yml were touched. Verdict is PASS.

findings.claim: scripts/perf002_prefill_path_probe.py passes all 8 selftest cases, verifying all 5 refusal rules (too_few_distinct_x, negative_slope, r2_below_bound, bimodal, implausibly_fast), anti-vacuity, control pass, and slope recovery.
scripts/perf002_prefill_path_probe.sh passes syntax validation, establishes bail_marker prior to repo resolution or apr_bin sourcing, and ensures UNMEASURABLE is consistently reported on exit 2.
The diff satisfies all acceptance criteria of PMAT-3556 without editing restricted files or violating refutation doctrines.
